en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a town nestled at the base of steep, terraced mountains. The foreground shows dense urban blocks with multi‑story buildings and tree‑lined streets; in the middle distance rise church towers and older stone structures typical of a historic European city. The rugged hills behind dominate the scene. In the upper right corner the caption 'TRENTO-TRIENT' is printed.
